primary_math_proof: Actual labels put A at the apex and B,C,D,E around the square base. Let common original edge length be s>0. Then AB=AD=s, while BD is the square diagonal s*sqrt2, not one of the eight original edges. Triangle ABD is right isosceles at A, so ABD=45deg uniquely. Equivalently its B cosine is1/sqrt2. The genuine side face ABC is equilateral, giving ABC=60deg; the genuine square-base triangle BCD gives CBD=45deg. However rays BA,BC,BD are not coplanar: with s=1 their scalar triple product has magnitude1/sqrt2. Hence subtracting60-45 is invalid.
specific_wrong_geometric_rule: Treat raysBA,BC,BD as coplanar and subtract angleCBD=45deg from angleABC=60deg, returningABD=15deg. In3D their scalar triple product is nonzero, so this difference rule is false; the actual target is45deg.
design_difference: Old equal_color_diagonal colored wholeABD and assigned diagonal the common edge length; old equilateral_capture colored wholeABC and confused its60deg withABD. Both had preset60 and45/45 finals. New design uses a shared BC reference and3distinct ray roles, preset15 from the specific invalid cross-plane subtraction60-45. It neither treatsBD as an eighth original edge nor merely recolors either old closed triangle.
marker_roles: BA is one true lateral edge of equilateral faceABC and the first target ray ofABD.
BC is the shared reference ray for the true60deg face angleABC and true45deg base angleCBD. It has a specific angular comparison role.
BD is the true square-base diagonal and second target ray, added as a dashed auxiliary between exact named B/D. It is not counted as an original pyramid edge.
